proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the gearbox casting number/ID plate (bellhousing side and main housing) with readable text.
Send photos showing the gearbox ports/connectors (sensor plugs, shifter/selector area, cooler line fittings) and confirm what is included.
Send a short video showing the gearbox being rotated/checked and any bench test results (or fluid drained condition).
Confirm the exact GMC Sierra year(s) and engine (V8 model) the gearbox fits, and show the part number match.
